articles.title: R METAL

controls.label: R METAL
controls.effect: Red channel of the spec map: Metallic (brighter = more metal)

articles.title: Refresh (spec channel strip...)

articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > spec channel strip under the preview.
when: Preview is stale, blank or not changing.

controls.label: Refresh
controls.effect: Refresh preview (F5): aborts a stuck render and re-runs the live preview

articles.title: RENDER
articles.summary: RENDER (Ctrl+R): builds the finished paint TGA and the spec TGA and writes them to the iRacing car folder. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > centre > RENDER button.
when: When the look is right and you want it in iRacing.

controls.label: RENDER
controls.effect: RENDER (Ctrl+R): builds the finished paint TGA and the spec TGA and writes them...

pitfalls: It will not start if the paint, customer ID or car folder is missing, or template layers are still on.

articles.title: Copy Card
articles.summary: Copies the recipe card picture to the clipboard (paste into Discord). It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > after RENDER > recipe card window. Copy the recipe card image to the clipboard - paste straight into Discord.

controls.label: Copy Card
controls.effect: Copies the recipe card picture to the clipboard (paste into Discord)

combos.why: Works together with the Save Card PNG control.

articles.title: Save Card PNG
articles.summary: Save this recipe card as a PNG image file. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > after RENDER > recipe card window.

controls.label: Save Card PNG
controls.effect: Save this recipe card as a PNG image file

articles.title: Share Recipe
articles.summary: Downloads this look as a .shokkerrecipe file with preview. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > after RENDER > recipe card window.

controls.label: Share Recipe
controls.effect: Downloads this look as a .shokkerrecipe file with preview

combos.why: Works together with the Import Recipe control.

articles.title: Copy TP Desc
articles.summary: copy Trading Paints description (zone finishes, colors) to clipboard. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > after RENDER > recipe card window.

controls.label: Copy TP Desc
controls.effect: copy Trading Paints description (zone finishes, colors) to clipboard

articles.title: Save to keep
articles.summary: Copies this render to a subfolder so the next render does not overwrite it. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > after RENDER > recipe card window.

controls.label: Save to keep
controls.effect: Copies this render to a subfolder so the next render does not overwrite it

combos.why: Works together with the Recent renders control.

articles.title: Recent renders
articles.summary: recall one of the last 10 saved renders and restore its full recipe. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > after RENDER > recipe card window.

controls.label: Recent renders
controls.effect: recall one of the last 10 saved renders and restore its full recipe

articles.title: Deploy to a different car
articles.summary: This render is already in the active car's iRacing folder (Live Link). It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > after RENDER > recipe card > deploy row. Open this to also copy it into a different car's folder.

controls.label: Deploy to a different car
controls.effect: This render is already in the active car's iRacing folder (Live Link)

articles.title: Deploy Car Select
articles.summary: Pick another iRacing car to also copy this render to. It is a drop-down menu.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > after RENDER > recipe card > deploy row. Choices: Select car....
when: Same paint on a second car.
how: Open the menu and pick a choice.

controls.label: Deploy Car Select
controls.effect: Pick another iRacing car to also copy this render to

combos.why: Works together with the Deploy Now control.

articles.title: Deploy Now
articles.summary: Copies this render to the chosen car's iRacing folder. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > after RENDER > recipe card > deploy row.

controls.label: Deploy Now
controls.effect: Copies this render to the chosen car's iRacing folder

combos.why: Works together with the Deploy Car Select control.
